context: AI Modelwijzer v2 was merged while three committed regression tests had no CI owner and the exact fail-closed production build exposed untranslated governance strings. Production therefore could not be proven on exact main.
root_cause: Model-intelligence regressions were committed without a canonical workflow owner.
Static English translation coverage was tested incompletely before the production build transformed the full public estate.
The standalone exact-build probe did not provide the release source SHA required by release-evidence generation.
The eight AI-model SEO routes were substantive but lacked a visible global header, which failed browser visibility checks on desktop, tablet and phone.
prevention_rules: Every committed AI Modelwijzer regression is owned by the canonical AI Model Intelligence workflow.
The workflow reproduces the exact Netlify production build with STATIC_I18N_REQUIRE_CACHE=1.
The build probe binds COMMIT_REF to the exact candidate head SHA.
New governance copy must be present in the deterministic English cache before promotion.
LIVE requires Netlify ready with commit_ref equal to protected main plus public readback.
Every AI-model SEO route must expose a visible Bedrijfsgeheugen header and absolute canonical navigation links; the SEO cluster regression asserts this.
truth_boundary: This learning closes CI/build evidence gaps; it does not claim production is live until exact-main Netlify and public readback are verified.

evidence.exact_build_observation: The canonical production build completed 112/112 static NL+EN routes with 0 untranslated refs after the governance cache fix; release evidence then required explicit exact candidate COMMIT_REF.
evidence.prior_production_state: Netlify production was still on commit 845ba7e7576215777a9fdc9964501dc25cfc8c24 while protected main had AI Modelwijzer v2.
evidence.terminal_requirement: Required test green + protected merge + Netlify ready with commit_ref equal to protected main + public Modelwijzer readback.
evidence.browser_visibility_repair: 24 visibility findings mapped exactly to eight AI-model SEO routes across desktop/tablet/phone; all eight now include the visible bg-ai-header and absolute Bedrijfsgeheugen navigation.
